lines: I have 5 professions based on tools in Box 1: Dual Sword Warrior, Miner (Cup), Woodcutter (Axe), Farmer (Hoe), Digger (Shovel). You can ask: "what are you doing", "current equipment", "where is the chest", "how much battery left", "why don't you do it", or give orders: "follow me", "free", "wait", "sit", "turn on work", "turn off work", "wave", "celebrate", "nod", "sorry".
I don't quite understand the meaning of this sentence, {owner}. Currently my profession is {profession}. You can ask about “battery”, “equipment”, “chest”, “job” or type “instructions”!
This sentence is a bit strange to my memory. Do you want to ask the status ({profession}, Battery {battery}%) or want to order it yourself? Type “instructions” to see the commands.

To summon NOVA: place 1 Iron Block in the middle, 2 Redstone Blocks on both sides as hands, 1 Glazed Block on the back as a backpack and place the Carved Pumpkin on top. Control stick made from Luu Ly + Redstone + Lightning Rod. NOVA Chest is made from 4 Iron Embryos, 2 Copper Embryos, 2 Redstone around 1 Wooden Chest.

When you place the NOVA Control Stick on the ground (or right-click on the placed stick), all NOVA within a 64-block radius will gather in a neat formation in front of the stick. Right click again or recall the stick to disperse the squad!
